name: OrbitingParticles
description: Canvas orbital particle field with elliptical trajectories, Z-depth scale and opacity modulation, pointer gravity shift, and automatic RAF cleanup.
a11yNotes: Marks the canvas aria-hidden='true', cleans up requestAnimationFrame and resize listeners on unmount, and renders a static orbital ring under prefers-reduced-motion.

propsApi.name: particleColor
propsApi.description: Hex color of the orbiting particles.
